ImpactIQItemEmptyView_Description: ImpactIQ provides automated Power BI & Fabric governance by extracting metadata from your reports, models, dataflows, and workspaces into a Fabric Lakehouse. Configure your extraction settings to get started.
ImpactIQItemEmptyView_SetupButton_Descri: Set up your Lakehouse schema, workspace scope, and deployment settings.
ImpactIQ_Config_Schema_Hint: Schema name in your Lakehouse. 'dbo' is the typical default.
ImpactIQ_Config_LakehouseName_Hint: Name for the Lakehouse that will store governance metadata.
ImpactIQ_Config_Workspaces_Hint: Enter 'All' to scan all workspaces, or comma-separated workspace names (max 10).
ImpactIQ_Config_Workers_Hint: Number of parallel API calls (1-10). Higher = faster but more API load.
ImpactIQ_Status_Subtitle: Automated Power BI & Fabric metadata extraction into your Lakehouse. Save your configuration, then deploy the notebook, lakehouse, and pipeline to your workspace.
ImpactIQ_Status_NeverRun: No extraction has been run yet. Deploy and run the notebook to extract metadata.
ImpactIQ_Status_Tables_Desc: These tables will be created in your Lakehouse after running the governance extraction notebook.
ImpactIQ_Tables_Environment_Desc: Workspaces, datasets, reports, dataflows, apps, and refresh history
ImpactIQ_Tables_Model_Desc: Tables, columns, measures, relationships, calculation groups, and dependencies
ImpactIQ_Tables_Report_Desc: Visuals, pages, bookmarks, filters, visual objects, and report-level measures
ImpactIQ_Tables_Dataflow_Desc: Dataflow queries and M expressions for Gen1 and Gen2 dataflows
